steps.title: Shape detectives

options.label: Choose the flat shape with three straight sides.
Which whole object is a solid cube?
This shape has turned. What is its name now?

steps.hint: Trace the sides with your finger and count them.
steps.explanation: Use sides, corners and flat or solid parts to recognise shapes.
steps.shortExplanation: Make, count or compare the objects. Explain what changed.

mathWorkshop.title: Shape detectives
mathWorkshop.goal: Use sides, corners and flat or solid parts to recognise shapes.

tasks.prompt: Choose the flat shape with three straight sides.
tasks.feedback: A triangle has three straight sides and three corners.
tasks.hint: Trace the sides with your finger and count them.

tasks.prompt: Which whole object is a solid cube?
tasks.feedback: The cube is solid. A square is the flat shape on each of its faces.
tasks.hint: Look for a shape with depth, rather than only a flat drawing.

tasks.prompt: This shape has turned. What is its name now?
tasks.feedback: It is still a square. Turning leaves its four equal sides and four corners unchanged.
tasks.hint: Count the sides and corners. Turning does not stretch the shape.

parentReview.en: Guided practice is ungraded. Completion records the child doing the activities, not a book-question score.

steps.title: Naming flat shapes
steps.prompt: Match each flat shape to its name.
steps.hint: Count the straight sides and the corners of each shape.
steps.explanation: Count straight sides and corners to name the shapes.
steps.shortExplanation: Count straight sides and corners to name the shapes.

steps.title: Shape riddle
steps.prompt: I have 4 corners and 4 equal sides. What am I?
steps.hint: Which shapes have 4 corners? Which one has all its sides the same?
steps.explanation: A square has 4 equal sides and 4 corners.
steps.shortExplanation: A square has 4 equal sides and 4 corners.

steps.title: Solid riddle
steps.prompt: I have 6 square faces and 8 corners. What am I?
steps.hint: Think of a dice and count its square faces.
steps.explanation: A cube has 6 square faces and 8 corners.
steps.shortExplanation: A cube has 6 square faces and 8 corners.

steps.title: Triangle facts
steps.hint: Touch each side of a triangle, then each corner.
steps.explanation: A triangle has 3 sides and 3 corners.
steps.shortExplanation: A triangle has 3 sides and 3 corners.

steps.title: Shapes that roll
steps.prompt: Choose all the shapes that can roll.
steps.hint: A shape with a curved surface can roll.
steps.explanation: Spheres and cylinders have curved parts that let them roll.
steps.shortExplanation: Spheres and cylinders have curved parts that let them roll.

steps.title: Flat or solid
steps.prompt: Sort flat drawings and solid objects.
steps.hint: Could you hold it and turn it in your hand?
steps.explanation: Flat drawings are 2D. Objects you can hold are 3D.
steps.shortExplanation: Flat drawings are 2D. Objects you can hold are 3D.

source.answerKeyText: 2D: square, triangle, circle • 3D: ball, tin, dice

steps.title: Turning a square
steps.prompt: A square turned onto its corner is still a square.
steps.hint: Count its sides and corners after turning. Did they change?
steps.explanation: Turning does not change its 4 equal sides or 4 corners.
steps.shortExplanation: Turning does not change its 4 equal sides or 4 corners.

source.answerKeyText: True. It still has 4 equal sides and 4 corners.

steps.title: Triangles in a house
steps.prompt: This house is made of squares, rectangles and triangles. How many triangles can you find?
steps.hint: Look at the roof and the flags. Count every shape with three sides.
steps.explanation: The roof is a triangle and the two flags beside the house are triangles: 3 triangles.
steps.shortExplanation: The roof is a triangle and the two flags beside the house are triangles: 3 triangles.

source.answerKeyText: Any house built from the named shapes; the number of triangles must match his drawing.

steps.title: A football
steps.hint: Is a football flat or solid? Is it round all over?
steps.explanation: A football is solid and round all over, like a sphere.
steps.shortExplanation: A football is solid and round all over, like a sphere.

steps.title: A cereal box
steps.hint: Are all its faces squares, or are some long rectangles?
steps.explanation: A cereal box has rectangle faces, so it is a cuboid.
steps.shortExplanation: A cereal box has rectangle faces, so it is a cuboid.

steps.title: Rectangle corners
steps.hint: Touch each corner of a rectangle and count.
steps.explanation: A rectangle has four corners, like a door.
steps.shortExplanation: A rectangle has four corners, like a door.

steps.title: No corners
steps.hint: Run your finger round each shape. Which one never turns a corner?
steps.explanation: A circle is round all the way, so it has no corners.
steps.shortExplanation: A circle is round all the way, so it has no corners.

steps.title: A print in sand
steps.prompt: A tin pushed into sand leaves the print of a...
steps.hint: Look at the flat end of a tin. What shape is it?
steps.explanation: The flat end of a tin is a circle.
steps.shortExplanation: The flat end of a tin is a circle.

stickers.meaning: An edge of a flat shape.

homeActivities.text: Find safe objects shaped like a cube, cuboid, sphere, cylinder or cone. Predict which roll or stack, then test and trace flat faces.
homeActivities.textAr: دوّروا في البيت على حاجات آمنة شكلها مكعب أو متوازي مستطيلات أو كورة أو أسطوانة أو مخروط. توقعوا أنهي هتتدحرج وأنهي تترص فوق بعض، وبعدين جرّبوا، وارسموا حوالين الوشوش المسطحة.
homeActivities.safety: An adult supervises. Keep small objects away from younger children. An adult handles scissors. Use water at the sink, away from electrical items.
homeActivities.safetyAr: لازم شخص كبير يكون موجود. خلّي الحاجات الصغيرة بعيد عن الأطفال الأصغر، والكبير يمسك المقص. أنشطة المية تكون عند الحوض وبعيد عن الكهرباء.

goalActivities.text: Find a circle, a triangle, a square and a rectangle at home (a plate, half a sandwich, a tile, a door). Name each shape together.
goalActivities.textAr: دوّروا في البيت على دايرة ومثلث ومربع ومستطيل (طبق، نص سندوتش، بلاطة، باب). سمّوا كل شكل مع بعض.
goalActivities.safety: An adult supervises. Keep small objects away from younger children. An adult handles scissors. Use water at the sink, away from electrical items.
goalActivities.safetyAr: لازم شخص كبير يكون موجود. خلّي الحاجات الصغيرة بعيد عن الأطفال الأصغر، والكبير يمسك المقص. أنشطة المية تكون عند الحوض وبعيد عن الكهرباء.

goalActivities.text: Measure the sides of a square tile or paper with a piece of string. Your child checks that all 4 sides are the same.
goalActivities.textAr: قيسوا أضلاع بلاطة أو ورقة مربعة بحتة خيط. طفلك يتأكد إن الـ٤ أضلاع قد بعض.
goalActivities.safety: An adult supervises. Keep small objects away from younger children. An adult handles scissors. Use water at the sink, away from electrical items.
goalActivities.safetyAr: لازم شخص كبير يكون موجود. خلّي الحاجات الصغيرة بعيد عن الأطفال الأصغر، والكبير يمسك المقص. أنشطة المية تكون عند الحوض وبعيد عن الكهرباء.

goalActivities.text: Hold a dice or a cube-shaped box. Count its square faces, then its corners, together.
goalActivities.textAr: امسكوا حجر زهر أو علبة شكلها مكعب. عدّوا وشوشها المربعة، وبعدين أركانها، مع بعض.
goalActivities.safety: An adult supervises. Keep small objects away from younger children. An adult handles scissors. Use water at the sink, away from electrical items.
goalActivities.safetyAr: لازم شخص كبير يكون موجود. خلّي الحاجات الصغيرة بعيد عن الأطفال الأصغر، والكبير يمسك المقص. أنشطة المية تكون عند الحوض وبعيد عن الكهرباء.

goalActivities.text: Make a triangle with 3 straws or pencils on the table. Count the sides, then the corners.
goalActivities.textAr: اعملوا مثلث بـ٣ شفاطات أو أقلام على الترابيزة. عدّوا الأضلاع، وبعدين الأركان.
goalActivities.safety: An adult supervises. Keep small objects away from younger children. An adult handles scissors. Use water at the sink, away from electrical items.
goalActivities.safetyAr: لازم شخص كبير يكون موجود. خلّي الحاجات الصغيرة بعيد عن الأطفال الأصغر، والكبير يمسك المقص. أنشطة المية تكون عند الحوض وبعيد عن الكهرباء.

goalActivities.text: Gently roll a ball, a tin, a box and a dice on the floor. Sort them: rolls or does not roll.
goalActivities.textAr: جرّبوا تدحرجوا كورة وعلبة صفيح وعلبة كرتون وحجر زهر على الأرض بالراحة. قسّموهم: بيتدحرج ومش بيتدحرج.
goalActivities.safety: An adult supervises. Keep small objects away from younger children. An adult handles scissors. Use water at the sink, away from electrical items.

goalActivities.text: Put solid things (a tin, a ball, a box) next to their outlines drawn on paper. Talk about which ones you can hold and which are flat.
goalActivities.textAr: حطّوا حاجات مجسّمة (علبة صفيح، كورة، علبة) جنب رسمتها على ورق. اتكلموا أنهي ينفع نمسكه وأنهي مسطّح.
goalActivities.safety: An adult supervises. Keep small objects away from younger children. An adult handles scissors. Use water at the sink, away from electrical items.
goalActivities.safetyAr: لازم شخص كبير يكون موجود. خلّي الحاجات الصغيرة بعيد عن الأطفال الأصغر، والكبير يمسك المقص. أنشطة المية تكون عند الحوض وبعيد عن الكهرباء.

goalActivities.text: An adult cuts a paper square. Turn it onto a corner and check together: still 4 equal sides and 4 corners.
goalActivities.textAr: الكبير يقص مربع من ورق. لفّوه على ركنه واتأكدوا مع بعض: لسه ٤ أضلاع متساوية و٤ أركان.
goalActivities.safety: An adult supervises. Keep small objects away from younger children. An adult handles scissors. Use water at the sink, away from electrical items.

goalActivities.text: Draw a house together using squares, rectangles and triangles. Count the triangles together.
goalActivities.textAr: ارسموا بيت مع بعض من مربعات ومستطيلات ومثلثات. عدّوا المثلثات مع بعض.
goalActivities.safety: An adult supervises. Keep small objects away from younger children. An adult handles scissors. Use water at the sink, away from electrical items.
goalActivities.safetyAr: لازم شخص كبير يكون موجود. خلّي الحاجات الصغيرة بعيد عن الأطفال الأصغر، والكبير يمسك المقص. أنشطة المية تكون عند الحوض وبعيد عن الكهرباء.

goalActivities.text: Hold a football and an orange. Your child feels that they are round all over: both are spheres.
goalActivities.textAr: امسكوا كورة وبرتقانة. طفلك يحسّ إنهم مدوّرين من كل ناحية: الاتنين كرة.
goalActivities.safety: An adult supervises. Keep small objects away from younger children. An adult handles scissors. Use water at the sink, away from electrical items.

goalActivities.text: Look at a cereal or tissue box. Count its faces together and see that some are long rectangles: it is a cuboid.
goalActivities.textAr: بصّوا على علبة كورن فليكس أو مناديل. عدّوا وشوشها مع بعض، وشوفوا إن فيها مستطيلات طويلة: دي متوازي مستطيلات.

goalActivities.text: Draw round a book on paper. Your child counts the corners of the rectangle: 4.
goalActivities.textAr: ارسموا حوالين كتاب على ورقة. طفلك يعدّ أركان المستطيل: ٤.

goalActivities.text: Draw round a cup and a box. Run a finger round each shape and find the one with no corners.
goalActivities.textAr: ارسموا حوالين كوباية وعلبة. مشّوا صباعكم حوالين كل شكل ودوّروا على اللي مالوش أركان.

goalActivities.text: Press the bottom of a tin into play dough or sand, then lift it. Your child names the shape of the print.
goalActivities.textAr: اضغطوا قاع علبة صفيح في صلصال أو رمل وارفعوها. طفلك يقول شكل الأثر اسمه إيه.

parentNote.en: Every question is answered in the app; each goal has a home activity to try together. Estimate first; a guess is not a scored answer.
parentNote.ar: كل الأسئلة الطفل بيحلها جوه البرنامج، ولكل هدف نشاط تعملوه مع بعض في البيت. التوقع الأول مش إجابة عليها درجات.
